paper.abstract_en: Recent critiques have addressed certain aspects of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) effective metric (Ong 2023). This study presents a scale-dependent quadratic GUP effective metric, constructed through analyses of the gravity-induced phase shift (COW experiment) and the Einstein-Bohr photon box Gedanken experiment. In contrast to the procedure outlined in (Xiang et al. 2018), the momentum-dependent metric is improved by introducing an interpolating function $Δp (r)$, which employs the effective distance concept to accurately capture the distinct behavior of $Δp (r)$ in both short and long distance regimes. The resulting effective metric exhibits the same structure as that derived from the Renormalization Group (RG) theory. However, the RG parameter $\hatγ$ can now be related to the dimensionless GUP parameter $β_0$, thereby distinguishing this metric from the RG-based approach. The corresponding effective metric prediction demonstrates internal consistency of the model, and phenomenologically the predictions are in agreement with some quantum black hole models in some limits. The effective metric improved black hole thermodynamics and shadow predictions compared to the heuristic approach and other proposed GUP effective metrics. Furthermore, the relationship between GUP and $f(R)$ gravity (D'Agostino et al. 2026) may provide a possible future route toward a more fundamental description of GUP.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了一种尺度依赖的二次广义不确定原理有效度规，通过引力诱导相移和爱因斯坦-玻尔光子箱思想实验进行分析，引入插值函数以改进动量依赖度规，并证明其与重整化群结构一致但参数可关联，同时改善了黑洞热力学和阴影预测，具有理论深度和现象学意义。
decision.title_zh: 量子引力启发的广义不确定原理有效度规
decision.abstract_zh: 最近的批评已涉及广义不确定原理（GUP）有效度规的某些方面（Ong 2023）。本研究提出了一种尺度依赖的二次GUP有效度规，通过引力诱导相移（COW实验）和爱因斯坦-玻尔光子箱思想实验的分析构建。与（Xiang等人2018）中概述的程序相比，动量依赖度规通过引入插值函数Δp(r)得到改进，该函数利用有效距离概念精确捕捉Δp(r)在短距离和长距离区域的不同行为。所得有效度规具有与从重整化群（RG）理论推导出的相同结构。然而，RG参数γ̂现在可以与无量纲GUP参数β₀相关联，从而将该度规与基于RG的方法区分开来。相应的有效度规预测证明了模型的内在一致性，并且在现象学上，预测在某些极限下与一些量子黑洞模型一致。与启发式方法和其他提出的GUP有效度规相比，该有效度规改进了黑洞热力学和阴影预测。此外，GUP与f(R)引力之间的关系（D'Agostino等人2026）可能为未来走向更基本的GUP描述提供一条可能的路线。
